sloka: ततो अहम् तत्र निक्षिप्तो गुहा द्वारि विनीतवत् ।न च निष्क्रमते वाली तदा संवत्सरे गते ॥४-४६-५॥
transliteration: tato aham tatra nikṣipto guhā dvāri vinītavat ।na ca niṣkramate vālī tadā saṁvatsare gate ॥4-46-5॥

translations.english: 'Then I waited at the entrance of the cave with due loyalty. A year passed. Yet Vali did not return.
